errorFallback.title: Something went wrong
errorFallback.body: An unexpected error occurred. Try reloading the page.

void.title: Void {{code}}?
void.description: A document is never edited — void it and write a new one. The reason stays in the journal.

errors.notYourDocument: Only the author or the owner can void a document
errors.shiftClosed: The shift is closed — ask the network owner to void it

explainDialog.title: Explain the {{amount}} discrepancy
explainDialog.description: A discrepancy never blocks closing a shift — the operator already closed it. This explanation does not change the count; it stays in the journal alongside it.

recount.title: Cash recount
recount.body: Count the cash in the drawer and enter the amount. What it should be stays hidden until you enter it — otherwise this would not be a recount.
recount.amount: How much is in the drawer, ₴

result.note: This figure cannot be changed in the app. Call the base — the owner will find where it went off.

errors.amount: Enter the amount you counted in the drawer — a number, not less than zero.
errors.noOpenShift: A recount does not attach to a closed shift — you can only count while the shift is open.

pointCash.title: Point cash
pointCash.description: How much cash the point should have on hand right now, and how much is missing from its target. Berry cash and crate deposits are two separate books — neither borrows from the other.

errors.pointMissing: This point does not exist — pick another one

stats.targetUnset: no target assigned to this point yet
stats.cashHint: cash available to pay for berries
stats.neverCounted: Never counted yet: the first count when the shift opens sets the opening balance.
stats.shortfallOwed: the base has not transferred it yet
stats.shortfallOver: there is more in the drawer than the target

ledger.title: Where this number comes from
ledger.accruedTodayTruncated: Showing recent receipts only — older ones may be missing from this total.
ledger.paidPastTruncated: Showing recent payouts only — older ones may be missing from this total.
ledger.cashInTruncated: Showing recent transfers only — older ones may be missing from this total.
ledger.negative: Berry cash has gone negative: the target does not cover this day. This is not a data-entry mistake — it means more was paid out than the point had in berry cash.
ledger.twoRowsNote: Payouts show as two rows on purpose: a day can pay out more than it earned, because old balances get settled too — one "paid out" figure would not explain that.

crates.title: Crate cash
crates.footnote: This money sits apart from the berry cash: we pay someone for their crates even if the berry drawer is empty. No deposit was taken against a signed receipt — those crates are not counted here.

incoming.loadFailed: Could not load the transfers on their way

countHistory.title: Cash counts
countHistory.empty: No cash counts recorded for this point yet.

panel.title: Shift and recount
panel.recountsEmpty: The drawer has not been recounted today.

actions.openCaption: a recount attaches to an open shift
actions.closedNote: This day's shift is already settled. A second book is never opened for the same drawer, and a recount does not attach to a closed shift.
actions.openPastDayNote: The shift is still open, but it is not today's — its actions live on its own day
actions.noShiftNote: There is no shift for this day — there is nothing for a recount to attach to.

panel.footnote: The drawer can be recounted as many times a day as needed — every recount stays its own record and corrects nothing.
panel.readFailed: The shift could not be read — reload the page

result.closedDiscrepancy: Shift closed. Discrepancy {{amount}} — the owner will see it on their own list.

preview.shortfall: Will fall short of the target

pointTarget.note: The drawer isn't recounted: only the figure used to measure "short of the target" changes.
pointTarget.overTarget: There's already more in the drawer than this target. There will be no debt to the point at all — this can't be refused: a target is a management decision.

issue.description: Crates go home with a person. Both modes put the same crates on the same balance — the difference is only in the money.

return.description: Returns consume the oldest issuances first and refund each at the price it was taken at.

inField.empty.hint: Everything issued here has come back.
